purpose: Inventory of every item in and around the repository whose distribution rights are restricted, unknown, or conditional. Records the owner's stated proprietary scope separately from externally sourced material. Evidence only; no ownership or commercial decision is made here.
superseded: 2026-10-27: the owner has since authorised the standard MIT grant over the whole project, so the first-party owner-decision entries below no longer describe a proprietary scope. This file is the dated record of the 2026-10-26 audit; the governing classification is release-audit/license-boundary.json. The externally sourced material entries remain factual.

rights.restricted_no_grant: The upstream states no redistribution permission; no grant may be inferred from public availability.
rights.permissive_attribution_required: Permissive licence whose only condition is that the copyright and permission notice accompany copies or substantial portions.
rights.unverified: The licence could not be read from the upstream during the audit.
rights.conditional_separate_terms: The toolkit and the data it consumes are licensed separately.
rights.first_party_owner_decision: Material the owner has stated should remain proprietary.

legend.in_repository: whether any of the item's own source or data is committed to this repository

items.name: JB2008 empirical atmosphere model, official distribution
items.stated_terms: "Copyright, 2008, Space Environment Technologies. All rights reserved."
evidence: docs/atmosphere/JB2008.md line 37 quotes the copyright line.

docs/atmosphere/DECISIONS.md line 9 records that the archive's README points to a licence that is not supplied as an explicit grant and that no redistribution permission is inferred from public download.
docs/atmosphere/INPUTS.md line 234 records: jb2008.zip -> JB2008.f, acquisition sol.spacenvironment.net/JB2008/downloadables/, 'All rights reserved; acquired externally, not vendored'.
cmake/jb2008.cmake requires a local unmodified source file and enforces SHA-256 b18c1607239db881940a7b91635a7af39edc82306cf10854ec12080397227999.

in_repository_material_that_touches_it.assessment: declares 'no JB2008 equations are copied here'; verified by reading the whole file - it only declares an interface and calls JB2008.
declares 'Nothing of the official model is copied here'; verified by reading the whole file - moves doubles across stdin/stdout only.

in_repository_material_that_touches_it.kind: project-owned helper around the upstream SUNPOS and THETA subroutines
in_repository_material_that_touches_it.assessment: states THETA is not stored here; references the driver's own expressions in prose.
states THETA 'is not stored here' and that the upstream block is copied into the build directory at experiment time, so no upstream code is redistributed by the repository.
declares 'THETA is extracted byte-for-byte out of tree'.

items.method: All seven .f90 files were read in full and scanned for model-equation markers (polynomial coefficients, density/temperature model terms, COMMON blocks). None contains model equations; the only constants present are PI = 3.1415927D0 and DG2RD = PI/180 in jb2008_official_grid_check.f90, which reproduce the driver driver's numerical constants rather than its code.
items.residual_risk: The scan covers the in-repo files. It cannot rule out derivation in the C++ adapter that was not detected by inspection of the Fortran wrappers; a qualified reviewer with the official JB2008.f in hand would be needed for a definitive clearance.
items.distribution_impact: Official external model/toolkit sources are not vendored. BASELINE packaging did include first-party provider adapters/glue because source inclusion was broad. FINAL conservative52-file public boundary excludes those adapters and forbids them in SKBUILD. No claim that the baseline sdist excluded all proprietary integration source is made.

items.name: Project Svarog / SolarSailPropagator.jl (Julia)
items.vendor: Imperial College Space Society (github org: ImperialSpaceSociety)
items.stated_terms: MIT License, "Copyright (c) 2022 Imperial College Space Society"
evidence: Upstream README at the commit the project cites, 58ab4d4964f9c20b7070efae48f8916e8a99784e: '## License' / 'MIT - see LICENSE'.
legacy/LICENSE in the read-only local checkout /home/user/Project-Svarog-Orbital: the MIT text with 'Copyright (c) 2022 Imperial College Space Society'.
docs/stage3.md lines 288-300 map the upstream's src/Analysis.jl and src/EnsembleIO.jl onto the project's C++ analysis equivalents and cite upstream commit 58ab4d4964f9c20b7070efae48f8916e8a99784e.

docs/numerical-audit/experiments/provenance.json and docs/numerical-audit/experiments/CASE-B-v1.cfg cite the upstream's examples/earth_orbit_acc.jl (lines 15-21 and 49-89) as the source of the CASE-B configuration; docs/numerical-audit/spacecraft_characteristics.py and docs/numerical-audit/evidence/spacecraft-characteristics.json carry that provenance.
items.retrieval_limitation: GET /repos/ImperialSpaceSociety/Project-Svarog-Orbital returns HTTP 404 on 2026-10-26 (deleted or private). The upstream LICENSE file was removed from the tree before the cited commit. The MIT grant is therefore evidenced by the README statement at that commit plus the local legacy/ copy, and not by a currently retrievable upstream LICENSE file.
items.open_gap: APPLICABILITY UNRESOLVED; PRECAUTIONARY ATTRIBUTION RECOMMENDED. MIT's condition attaches to copies or substantial portions of the Software. This audit established that the upstream is a real dependency of the project's design and that the three physics/analysis areas compared are re-implementations with different formulations rather than copies; it did NOT establish that a substantial portion is carried, and the substantial-portion test is a legal determination this audit does not make. The upstream source is not vendored, so there is no block of upstream text in the distribution to point at. What IS certain: no notice for this upstream exists anywhere in the baseline repository, and the upstream licence file is no longer retrievable from GitHub (HTTP 404), so any notice must state that it was reproduced from the local checkout at the cited commit, with the retrieval limitation attached. Recommendation: reproduce the upstream MIT notice as a precaution - one paragraph, and it removes the question.
items.derivation_assessment: Three compared physics/analysis algorithms differ; separately all40 fixed altitude/density anchors are inherited from upstream Constants.jl. Exact comparison recorded in boundary-independent-review.json. This is not a determination of legal substantiality or copyright/database rights.
items.identity_note: 'Imperial' in this provenance chain refers to the Imperial College Space Society upstream project. It is a different entity from the 'Imperial College London' string in the account's GitHub profile company field, which is self-declared affiliation metadata.
items.distribution_impact: The upstream source is not vendored. The attribution obligation travels with any distribution of the ported material.
